visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a medium shot of a young man with short dark hair, wearing a black t-shirt, seated at a table in a professional studio environment. He holds a large white square retail box featuring minimalist mechanical line art of a phone. The background consists of dark industrial shelving with decorative items and warm accent lighting. (2) The camera cuts to a close-up of the retail box. The man's hands point towards various icons and camera lens illustrations printed on the white surface. A large yellow text overlay at the top reads '2025最有特色的手機', while the creator smiles at the camera. (3) The creator pulls a clear plastic protective case from the packaging. As he displays it, a variety show style text overlay '亂七八糟!!' in yellow appears along with multiple white '哈哈' icons arranged in a circular pattern around his head. (4) A tight close-up shows a white USB-C charging cable with unique translucent plastic connectors, allowing internal wiring to be partially visible. The cable is neatly bundled with a white cardboard strap featuring a QR code. (5) The man holds the Nothing Phone 3, showcasing its transparent back panel filled with white internal components, screws, and circular coils. He points to a new feature: a small circular dot-matrix screen located in the top-right corner of the rear panel. (6) A screen recording demonstrates the 'Nothing OS' user interface, featuring monochromatic icons and dot-matrix font widgets. A variety text overlay '很帥耶' in yellow appears briefly at the bottom. (7) The creator demonstrates the Glyph screen's functionality by pressing a physical red button on the phone's side. The small circular display cycles through animations, including a digital clock and a 'Spin the Bottle' drinking game icon. (8) The circular Glyph screen is used as a selfie mirror. The dot-matrix screen displays a pixelated version of the man's face, and a bright white LED flash illuminates as the device captures a photograph. (9) In the final phase, the man speaks directly to the camera while holding the phone. He points out the physical side button again before the video ends on a close-up of him posing with the device.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to introduce and unbox the Nothing Phone 3, focusing heavily on its unique aesthetic appeal and the innovative Glyph dot-matrix screen. By demonstrating playful features like the 'Spin the Bottle' game and selfie mirror functionality, the creator highlights how the brand differentiates itself through design and user experience rather than just raw hardware specs.
